notes: Upright standing bird: torso is near-vertical (pelvis Z0.40 -> neck Z0.92), body centred at X~-0.10 (not 0). Two taloned legs; thigh runs forward-down to a hidden knee, shin back to the ankle, short tarsus; toes point forward (-Y). Head looks slightly down-forward, beak below head centre. Tall flame crest above the head: rigid-ish to head, could get 1-2 soft bones for flicker but keep budget. Flame tail fans low behind and curls toward +X; it touches the ground near the feet - keep its tip near ground in walk. Wings half-spread, partly folded: left wing smaller in silhouette than right.
